questions.text: Lucas _____ a bus to school every day.
questions.explanation: 主詞 Lucas 為第三人稱單數，表示現在習慣，動詞用 takes。

questions.text: Steven always _____ up early in the morning.
questions.explanation: 主詞 Steven 為第三人稱單數，always 搭配現在簡單式 gets。

questions.text: The Earth _____ around the Sun.
questions.explanation: 不變真理用現在簡單式，主詞單數用 moves。

questions.text: Knowledge _____ power.
questions.explanation: Knowledge 為不可數名詞，視為單數，be動詞用 is。

questions.text: Tina _____ a new dress last week.
questions.explanation: last week 表過去，buy 的過去式為 bought。

questions.text: There _____ a beautiful lake here five years ago.
questions.explanation: five years ago 表過去，lake 單數用 was。

questions.text: Jason _____ leave Taipei next month.
questions.explanation: 未來簡單式句型：S + will + VR。

questions.text: I am going to _____ my grandpa tomorrow.
questions.explanation: be going to 後接原形動詞 visit。

questions.text: The little girl _____ happily.
questions.explanation: 描述現在的事實，主詞單數 smiles（smile 為不及物動詞）。

questions.text: Chloe _____ her smartphone yesterday.
questions.explanation: yesterday 表過去，lose 過去式為 lost。

questions.text: Kevin thinks that English _____ useful.
questions.explanation: 客觀事實用現在簡單式，English 單數用 is。

questions.text: We _____ that you will have a bright future.
questions.explanation: 主詞 We 為複數，現在簡單式用原形 believe。

questions.text: You can _____ your own decisions.
questions.explanation: 助動詞 can 後面接原形動詞 make。
祈使句否定句 Don't 後面接原形動詞 worry。

questions.text: These will _____ you into a new you.
questions.explanation: 助動詞 will 後面接原形動詞 shape。

questions.text: Today _____ a big day.
questions.explanation: Today 單數，現在式 be 動詞用 is。

questions.text: You are going to _____ high school.
questions.explanation: be going to 後接原形動詞 start。

questions.text: Your school life _____ awesome.
questions.explanation: 預測未來狀況用未來簡單式 will be。

questions.text: You _____ the power to shape your future.
questions.explanation: 主詞 You 用原形動詞 have。

questions.text: High school life will certainly _____ an unforgettable memory.
questions.explanation: will 後面接原形動詞 become。

questions.text: My father _____ to work by car every day.
questions.explanation: 主詞 My father 為第三人稱單數，every day 表現在簡單式 goes。

questions.text: They _____ baseball in the park yesterday afternoon.
questions.explanation: yesterday afternoon 表過去，play 過去式為 played。

questions.text: Susan _____ a doctor in the future.
questions.explanation: in the future 表未來，用未來簡單式 will be。

questions.text: Look! It _____ heavily outside.
questions.explanation: （若考現在簡單式常態）若為單純事實習慣，或填 rains。此處以現在簡單式為主：It rains a lot here.

questions.explanation: 科學真理用現在簡單式，Water 單數用 boils。

questions.explanation: usually 搭配現在簡單式，Helen 單數用 gets。

questions.text: He _____ me an interesting story last night.
questions.explanation: last night 表過去，tell 過去式為 told。

questions.explanation: next Sunday 表未來，用未來簡單式 will go。

questions.explanation: 自然真理用現在簡單式，The sun 單數用 rises。

questions.explanation: last night 表過去，cook 過去式為 cooked。

questions.explanation: 主詞 Children 複數，現在簡單式用 like。

questions.text: I _____ a letter to my friend tomorrow.

questions.explanation: 客觀事實複數主詞 Cats 用原形 chase。

questions.text: Which of the following sentences uses a sensory linking verb (感官連綴動詞) correctly with a predicate adjective?

options.text: The chef tasted the soup carefully in the kitchen.
The cake smells deliciously of fresh strawberries.
The velvet cushion feels extremely soft to the touch.
She looked angrily at her little brother.

questions.explanation: (C) 中的 feel 為連綴動詞接形容詞 soft；(A) 中 taste 為動作動詞；(B) smell 應接形容詞 delicious 而非副詞；(D) look 為動作動詞。

questions.text: Had you followed the doctor's advice, you _____ recovered from the serious illness much faster.
questions.explanation: 此為與過去事實相反的假設句倒裝句型（省略 if 倒裝），主要子句用情態動詞過去式 + have + p.p. (would have recovered)。

questions.text: Unless you _____ your mind, nobody can force you to make such a difficult decision.
questions.explanation: Unless（除非）引導條件子句，其語意相當於 if... not，且條件子句中須用現在式代替未來式，主詞 you 用 change。

questions.text: To our surprise, the traditional food from the night market tasted much _____ than we had expected.
questions.explanation: taste 為連綴動詞，後方接形容詞比較級 better 來修飾主詞 the traditional food。

questions.text: No matter what challenges you encounter in senior high school, you should never lose heart if failure _____.
questions.explanation: if 引導條件子句表未來或一般情況時用現在式，主詞 failure 單數用 occurs。
